actions.cancel_order.description: Cancel an open order. Once cancelled, the order cannot be reopened — the only path forward is to create a new order.
actions.cancel_order.props.idempotency_k: Advanced. A UUID v4 — if the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.
actions.cancel_order.props.order_id.desc: The Qawafel order ID (starts with `ord_`) you want to cancel.
actions.cancel_order.props.reason.descri: Optional but recommended. A short note explaining why the order is being cancelled (max 500 characters).
actions.create_invoice.description: Create an invoice in Qawafel for a customer. The invoice starts in `draft` state — use the **Generate Invoice** action (or call it from your dashboard) to finalize and issue a ZATCA-compliant copy.
actions.create_invoice.props.external_re: Optional. Store an ID from another system here (e.g. your ERP record ID) to link records across systems. Must be unique within Qawafel.
actions.create_invoice.props.idempotency: Advanced. A UUID v4 — if the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.
The date the invoice is issued. Use today for most cases. (YYY-MM-DD format)
One row per product on this invoice. Each row needs a product, quantity, unit price, and VAT %.
actions.create_invoice.props.notes.descr: Optional. Notes printed on the invoice or kept internal.
actions.create_invoice.props.order_id.de: Optional. The Qawafel order ID (`ord_…`) this invoice is for. Linking helps track fulfilment-to-billing.
actions.create_invoice.props.payment_due: Optional. The absolute final date payment is due (used for late-payment workflows). (YYY-MM-DD format)
actions.create_invoice.props.payment_sta: Optional. When the payment terms begin. (YYY-MM-DD format)
actions.create_invoice.props.shipping_fe: Optional. Delivery / shipping fees as a decimal string excluding VAT, e.g. `25.00`. Defaults to `0.00`.
actions.create_merchant.description: Add a new customer or supplier to your Qawafel tenant. Use this when onboarding a new B2B partner from your CRM, signup form, or another system.
actions.create_merchant.props.country.de: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. `SA` for Saudi Arabia.
actions.create_merchant.props.email.desc: Primary contact email for this merchant.
actions.create_merchant.props.external_r: Optional. Store an ID from another system here (e.g. your ERP record ID) to link records across systems. Must be unique within Qawafel.
actions.create_merchant.props.idempotenc: Advanced. A UUID v4 — if the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.
actions.create_merchant.props.is_taxable: Tick if this merchant is registered for VAT. Affects how invoices to/from them are calculated.
actions.create_merchant.props.legal_name: The official registered company name as it appears on the commercial registration.
actions.create_merchant.props.name_ar.de: The trade or store name in Arabic. Required by Qawafel for ZATCA-compliant invoices.
actions.create_merchant.props.name_en.de: The trade or store name in English. Shown on documents and dashboards.
actions.create_merchant.props.phone.desc: Primary phone number, including country code (e.g. `+966500000000`).
actions.create_merchant.props.postal_cod: Postal code (5 digits in Saudi Arabia).
actions.create_merchant.props.short_addr: Optional. National Address short code (4 letters + 4 digits, e.g. `RHRA1234`).
actions.create_merchant.props.type.descr: Pick **Customer** if this party buys from you, or **Supplier** if you buy from them.
actions.create_merchant.props.unified_na: Optional. Saudi Unified National Number (الرقم الوطني الموحد), 10 digits starting with `7`.
actions.create_merchant.props.vat_number: Optional. 15-digit VAT registration number, starts with `3`. Required if the merchant is VAT-registered.
actions.create_order.description: Sync a completed (fulfilled) order into Qawafel. Use this to import historical or externally-completed orders from another storefront, ERP, or B2B portal — the order is created directly in **Fulfilled** state and skips the normal fulfilment workflow. Do **not** use this for new orders that still need to be confirmed, picked, and delivered.
actions.create_order.props.country.descr: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. `SA` for Saudi Arabia, `AE` for the UAE.
actions.create_order.props.delivery_fees: Optional. Delivery fees as a decimal string, e.g. `15.00`. Required if you set a delivery method.
Required if you set a delivery method. Pick **Customer** to bill the buyer, or **Vendor** to absorb the fee.
actions.create_order.props.delivery_opti: Pick **Vendor** if you (the seller) deliver yourself, or **Courier** to use a delivery service.
Optional. Store an ID from another system here (e.g. your ERP record ID) to link records across systems. Must be unique within Qawafel.
actions.create_order.props.idempotency_k: Advanced. A UUID v4 — if the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.
actions.create_order.props.line_items.de: One row per product on this order. Each row needs a product, quantity, and unit price.
actions.create_order.props.merchant_id.d: The customer placing the order. Pick from your existing customer merchants — use "Create Merchant" first if they are new.
actions.create_order.props.notes.descrip: Optional. Internal notes attached to the order.
actions.create_order.props.postal_code.d: Postal code (5 digits in Saudi Arabia).
actions.create_order.props.short_address: Optional. The Saudi National Address short code (4 uppercase letters + 4 digits, e.g. `RHRA1234`).
actions.create_product.description: Add a new product to your Qawafel catalog. The workhorse for catalog sync from your ERP or storefront into Qawafel.
actions.create_product.props.barcode.des: Optional. UPC, EAN or GTIN barcode.
actions.create_product.props.description: Optional. Longer description shown on documents.
actions.create_product.props.external_re: Optional. Store an ID from another system here (e.g. your ERP record ID) to link records across systems. Must be unique within Qawafel.
actions.create_product.props.idempotency: Advanced. A UUID v4 — if the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.
actions.create_product.props.is_active.d: Active products show up in lookups and can be sold. Untick to soft-disable.
Tick this if 15% VAT applies to this product. Untick for VAT-exempt items.
actions.create_product.props.name_ar.des: Product name in Arabic. Required by Qawafel for ZATCA-compliant invoices.
actions.create_product.props.name_en.des: Product name in English. Shown on invoices and quotations.
actions.create_product.props.sku.descrip: Stock Keeping Unit — your unique product code. Must be unique within your Qawafel tenant.
actions.create_product.props.supplier_id: Required when **Product Type** is `Purchase`. Pick the supplier merchant this product is bought from. Leave blank for `Sale` products.
actions.create_product.props.type.descri: Pick **Sale** if this is a product you sell. Pick **Purchase** if it is a product you buy from a supplier (you must also pick the supplier below).
actions.create_product.props.type.option: Purchase (something you buy from a supplier)
Default price per unit in Saudi Riyals as a decimal string with two places, e.g. `99.00` or `1234.56`.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_invoice.description: Fetch a single invoice by its Qawafel ID. Returns the full invoice including line items, totals, ZATCA PDF URL, and current state.
actions.get_invoice.props.invoice_id.des: The Qawafel invoice ID (starts with `inv_`). Find this in a webhook payload, the "List Invoices" action, or the dashboard.
actions.get_order.description: Fetch a single order by its Qawafel ID. Returns the full order including line items, totals, delivery details, and current state.
actions.get_order.props.order_id.descrip: The Qawafel order ID (starts with `ord_`). You can get this from a trigger, the "List Orders" action, or your dashboard.
actions.get_product.description: Fetch a single product by its Qawafel ID. Returns the full product including price, descriptions, and active status.
actions.get_product.props.product_id.des: The Qawafel product ID (starts with `prod_`). You can find this on a product page in Qawafel, in the output of "List Products", or from a webhook trigger.
actions.list_invoices.description: Get invoices, optionally filtered by status, customer, or creation date. Returns up to 500 invoices (5 pages of 100).
actions.list_invoices.props.created_afte: Optional. Return only invoices created after this date and time.
Optional. Return only invoices for this customer. Leave blank for all customers.
actions.list_invoices.props.state.descri: Optional. Return only invoices in this state. Leave blank for all statuses.
actions.list_orders.description: Get orders, optionally filtered by status, customer, or creation date. Returns up to 500 orders (5 pages of 100).
Optional. Return only orders created after this date and time.
actions.list_orders.props.merchant_id.de: Optional. Return only orders from this customer. Leave blank for all customers.
actions.list_orders.props.state.descript: Optional. Return only orders in this state. Leave blank for all statuses.
actions.list_products.description: Get products from your catalog, with optional filters by type, supplier, SKU, and active status. Returns up to 500 products (5 pages of 100).
actions.list_products.props.created_afte: Optional. Return only products created after this date and time.
actions.list_products.props.is_active.de: Tick to return only active products, untick for inactive only. Leave blank to return both.
actions.list_products.props.sku.descript: Optional. Return only the product with this exact SKU (case-sensitive).
Optional. Only applies when filtering Purchase products. Pass a merchant ID (starts with `mer_`).
actions.list_products.props.type.descrip: Optional. `Sale` returns products you sell. `Purchase` returns products you buy from suppliers. Leave blank to return both.
actions.update_merchant.description: Edit a merchant's trade name or active state. Only the fields you fill in are updated. (Legal name, CR, VAT and other identity fields cannot be changed via the API.)
actions.update_merchant.props.idempotenc: Advanced. A UUID v4 — if the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.
Optional. Tick to keep the merchant active, untick to disable. Leave blank to keep the current value.
actions.update_merchant.props.merchant_i: Pick the merchant to update. Use "Create Merchant" first if they are not yet in Qawafel.
actions.update_merchant.props.name_ar.de: Optional. Leave blank to keep the current name.
actions.update_merchant.props.name_en.de: Optional. Leave blank to keep the current name.
actions.update_order_status.description: Move an order forward in the Qawafel fulfilment workflow. Qawafel enforces a strict state machine — for example, an order must be **Out for Delivery** before it can be marked **Delivered**. To cancel an order, use the **Cancel Order** action instead.
actions.update_order_status.props.idempo: Advanced. A UUID v4 — if the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.
actions.update_order_status.props.order_: The Qawafel order ID (starts with `ord_`). Get it from a webhook trigger, "List Orders", or your dashboard. Once you fill this in, the dropdown below only shows transitions valid for this order's current state.
actions.update_order_status.props.reason: Required when **New Status** is "Mark Not Delivered" — explains why delivery failed (max 500 characters). Ignored for all other transitions.
Reason (only used when marking Not Delivered)
actions.update_order_status.props.transi: Pick the next status. Only states reachable from the order's current state appear here. Workflow: Pending → Confirmed → Ready for Pickup → Out for Delivery → Delivered → Fulfilled.
actions.update_product.description: Edit a product's price, description, or active state. Only the fields you fill in are updated — leave the rest blank to keep them unchanged.
actions.update_product.props.description: Optional. New Arabic description. Leave blank to keep the current one.
Optional. New English description. Leave blank to keep the current one.
actions.update_product.props.idempotency: Advanced. A UUID v4 — if the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.
actions.update_product.props.is_active.d: Optional. Tick to keep the product active, untick to soft-disable. Leave blank to keep the current value.
Pick the product you want to change. Only the 100 most recent products are listed — use "List Products" if you need to find an older one.
Optional. New price per unit as a decimal string, e.g. `129.00`. Leave blank to keep the current price.
auth.description:
**How to get your Qawafel API Key:**

1. Sign in to your [Qawafel dashboard](https://qawafel.sa).
2. Open **Settings → Developers → API Keys**.
3. Click **Create API Key**, give it a name (e.g. "Activepieces") and copy the key.
4. Paste the key below. Keep it secret — anyone with the key can read and write your Qawafel data.

**Environment:**

- **Production** — live Qawafel tenant at `core.qawafel.sa`.
- **Development** — sandbox tenant at `core.development.qawafel.dev` for testing without touching live data.

API keys are scoped to a single environment. Pick the same one the key was created in.
auth.props.environment.description: Pick the Qawafel environment your API key belongs to.
description: B2B marketplace and ZATCA-compliant document platform — sync products, orders, merchants and invoices with Saudi Arabia's leading wholesale network.
triggers.invoice_paid.description: Fires when an invoice is marked as paid in Qawafel. Useful for posting payment receipts to Slack, releasing fulfilment, or syncing revenue to your books.
triggers.new_invoice.description: Fires when a ZATCA-compliant invoice is finalized in Qawafel (the `invoice.generated` event). Use it to email PDFs to customers, archive invoices to Drive, or push to your accounting system.
triggers.new_merchant.description: Fires when a new merchant (customer or supplier) is created in Qawafel. Use it to onboard customers in your CRM or add suppliers to your procurement system.
triggers.new_order.description: Fires the moment a new sales order is created in Qawafel. Use it to fan out to fulfillment, accounting, Slack alerts, or your CRM.
triggers.new_product.description: Fires when a new product is created in Qawafel. Use it to mirror your catalog into Shopify, Salla, Zid, or your data warehouse.
triggers.order_status_changed.descriptio: Fires when an order moves to a specific status (confirmed, out for delivery, delivered, fulfilled, cancelled, etc.). Pick one status per trigger — add the trigger again for additional statuses.
triggers.order_status_changed.props.stat: The flow runs every time an order transitions into the status you pick here.
triggers.product_updated.description: Fires when a product is updated (price change, description edit, activated/deactivated). Use it to keep external storefronts in sync.
triggers.refund_requested.description: Fires when a credit note is created against an invoice (i.e. a customer return or refund is initiated). Use it to alert your finance team or trigger a return workflow.
